properties.name: Kasbah of the Udayas
properties.description: Walled old fortress quarter above the mouth of the Bou Regreg river, with narrow whitewashed streets, gardens and Atlantic views.
properties.match_note: No OSM feature for the Kasbah as a whole among the candidates. Parts exist (Musee des Oudayas way/283167034, gates, cannons, viewpoints) but none is the Kasbah itself. Needs a decision: use one part as the pin, or add a separately documented point.

properties.name: Hassan Tower
aliases: Hassan Tower and Mausoleum of Mohammed V
properties.description: Unfinished medieval minaret beside the Mausoleum of Mohammed V; the two are usually visited together.
properties.match_note: OSM attraction polygon named Tour Hassan. The Mausoleum of Mohammed V is a separate OSM feature next to it (not used here).

properties.name: Chellah
